# Asia-Pacific Climate Change Adaptation Information Platform (AP-PLAT)

> AP-PLAT is a comprehensive platform bridging climate science and policy for Asia-Pacific adaptation, offering data tools, planning guidance, and capacity building supported by Japan's NIES and MOEJ.

Operated by the National Institute for Environmental Studies (NIES) and supported by Japan's Ministry of the Environment, AP-PLAT provides scientific resources, climate projections, and adaptation planning frameworks for stakeholders across the Asia-Pacific region. The platform integrates tools like ClimoCast and Climate Impact Viewer with UNFCCC-aligned guidance on National Adaptation Plans and climate finance mechanisms.

## Key Topics

- Climate Adaptation

## Platform Overview

- [Home](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp): Homepage for AP-PLAT, bridging science and stakeholders for climate adaptation
- [About AP-PLAT](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/about/index.html): Overview of AP-PLAT mission, supported by MOEJ and international climate initiatives
- [Get Started](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/get_started/index.html): Introduction to climate change science and adaptation based on IPCC findings

## Scientific Data & Tools

- [Scientific Data & Tools](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/data_tools/index.html): ClimoCast, Climate Impact Viewer, and databases for climate projections and adaptation

## Adaptation Planning & Policy

- [Adaptation Planning](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/adaptation_plan/index.html): Guidance on National Adaptation Plans and climate adaptation planning frameworks
- [Climate Finance & GCF Support](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/finance/gcf/index.html): Guide for developing GCF concept notes and climate finance applications in Asia-Pacific

## Capacity Building & Learning

- [Adaptation Literacy](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/adaptation_literacy/index.html): Training materials and e-learning resources for climate adaptation capacity development

## News & Activities

- [Activities](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/news/activities/index.html): News and activities on climate adaptation initiatives across Asia-Pacific region

## Optional

- [Maintenance](https://ap-plat.nies.go.jp/maintenance.html): Server maintenance notice for AP-PLAT and related tools
